# Stuart Romanek

Stuart Romanek is a designer and engineer working on product, brand, and open source software. He is the founding designer of ApostropheCMS.

Site: https://romanek.us/
Contact: sdr@romanek.us

## Work

- ApostropheCMS — open source CMS and in-context editing tools. https://apostrophecms.com
- Louis — a Make Your Own studio that turns YouTube content into playlists for the Yoto player. https://louis.romanek.us/ · https://github.com/stuartromanek/louis
- BLK MTN — identity and first major web release for an LA-based production and talent company
- The Andalusia Foundation — historic Biddle estate website (P'unk Avenue)
- The Orphan Disease Center — University of Pennsylvania / CHOP research site (P'unk Avenue)
- WRT — planners, urban designers, architects (P'unk Avenue)
- Center City District — Center City Philadelphia (P'unk Avenue)
